parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number, which must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The query end time, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EntityIdentity
parameters.description: The entity characteristic value, which can be used for fuzzy match on response entities.

parameters.name: OrderField
parameters.description:
The field used to sort results. Valid values:
- GmtModified: sorts results by update time.
- GmtCreate: sorts results by creation time.
- FinishTime: sorts results by policy end time.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page, with a maximum of 100.

parameters.name: PlaybookName
parameters.description: The unique identifier name of the playbook.

parameters.name: PlaybookTypes
parameters.description:
The playbook type. Valid values:
- system: manual handling
- custom: event-triggered playbook
- custom_alert: alert-triggered playbook
- soar-manual: manually run playbook
- soar-mdr: MDR-run playbook

parameters.name: RegionId

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The query start time, in milliseconds.
